metadata.title: Explicit second moments of symplectic Siegel transforms
metadata.abstract: We give two alternate formulations for the second moment formula of the Siegel transform over $\mathrm{Sp}(2n, \mathbb{Z}) \backslash \mathrm{Sp}(2n,\mathbb{R})$, originally established by Kelmer and Yu. We also provide several applications that demonstrate their usefulness.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: symplectic Siegel transform 的二阶矩
analysis.workSummary: 给出 Sp(2n,Z)\Sp(2n,R) 上 Siegel transform 二阶矩公式的两个替代形式，并展示相应应用。
analysis.breakthrough: 把既有二阶矩定理改写为更便于应用的表达。
analysis.limitations: 核心原始公式来自 Kelmer–Yu；摘要未列出各应用条件和数值常数。
